description: Complete FCL request in English to a Dutch forwarder (EUR quote from USD/EUR tariffs).

input.subject: RFQ: 2x40HC Shanghai - Rotterdam
input.body:
Hello Linkport team,

Could you please quote 2 x 40' high cube from Shanghai to Rotterdam, port to port, FOB Shanghai?
Commodity: LED lighting fixtures, approx. 9,800 kg per container. Cargo ready early November.

Best regards,
Hannah Okafor
Brightlane Imports Ltd
